summary: You complete Option 1 (one course in each of six core areas, with Minds and Machines counted for only one of Cognition and Logic & Computation) or Option 2 (SYMSYS 1 and an interdisciplinary concentration from the SSP website, which you move in by hand), for at least 18 units. Every course needs a letter grade of C- or better unless it is offered only S/NC.

4ls0P6xP.why: "An interdisciplinary SSP concentration is listed on the SSP website. To qualify, the selection of courses used for the minor must be interdisciplinary; it must either include courses from at least three departments or have more than one course from each of two departments." The list and the course count are not in the Bulletin.

alternatives.name: Option 1 or Option 2
alternatives.why: "Students may minor in Symbolic Systems by completing either Option 1 or Option 2."

program.why: Grading: "All courses must be taken for a letter grade, unless only offered S/NC. A minimum grade of 'C-' or better is required."
